entities.name: TMSI based NRI container
entities.description: An information element included by the UE during a combined attach procedure when it has a valid TMSI.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: A procedure where the UE performs both EPS attach and non-EPS services attach simultaneously.

entities.name: UE has valid TMSI
entities.description: Condition where the UE possesses a valid Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity.

relations.description: The combined attach procedure includes the TMSI based NRI container IE.
Inclusion of the TMSI based NRI container is conditional upon the UE having a valid TMSI.
